addition.item: Joomla update server wiring: <changelogurl> and <updateservers> in the package and library manifests so Joomla can poll for updates and show changelog details on the user side.
Akeeba Release System (ARS) integration for both the package (category 5, update stream 4) and the library (category 6, update stream 5).
Adopted the new cwm/build-tools shared release pipeline (composer release / bump / package / ars-publish / changelog / sync-languages / sync-configs).
Per-extension cwm-build.config.json describing the package layout, ARS endpoint, and changelog URL.
Empty changelog skeleton (build/cwmscripture-changelog.xml) that future releases append to via cwm-changelog.

change.item: Untangled component versions: each of the package, library, and bundled plugins now tracks its own version cadence. cwm-bump from this repo only touches the package wrapper manifest; the library bumps from its own repo, plugins bump only when their code changes.
Build script (build/build-package.php) now reads each component's version independently and self-verifies inner zip contents before exiting.
Standardized manifest metadata (authorEmail info@christianwebministries.org, copyright (C) 2026 CWM Team All rights reserved, creationDate May 2026).

note.item: This release is the first cut using the shared cwm/build-tools pipeline. ARS publish, changelog generation, and Joomla update polling are all live.
